test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To bell the cat
solution:
The correct answer is "**To face risk.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An idiom is an expression or phrase whose meaning does not relate to the literal meaning of its words.
 
 
• Example: "At arm's length" means keeping a safe distance.
 
 
 
• **The idiom "to bell the cat" means to undertake a dangerous or difficult task.**
 
• The phrase is often used to describe situations where someone must take on a difficult or dangerous task, even if it puts them at risk.
 
 
• Example: No one was ready to bell the car.
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the phrase "to face risk" is the correct meaning of the idiom "to bell the cat."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
